parts.name: Root
parts.description: Groups all items and manages selection state and roving focus.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled list of open item values.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially open item values when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new list of open item values after a user toggle.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Whether one (`'single'`) or several (`'multiple'`) panels can be open at once.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every item in the accordion.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Axis used for arrow-key navigation between triggers.

props.name: disallowEmptySelection
props.description: Keeps at least one panel open at all times.

props.name: loop
props.description: Whether trigger focus wraps at the first and last items.

props.name: id
props.description: Id applied to the root element. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered root element.

props.name: context
props.description: Externally created accordion context, for advanced composition.

dataAttributes.name: data-accordion-root
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the root element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The accordion orientation: 'vertical' or 'horizontal'.

parts.name: Item
parts.description: Wraps one collapsible section. Provides its value to Header, Trigger and Panel via context.

props.name: value
props.description: Unique value identifying the item. Header, Trigger and Panel read it from context.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered item element.

dataAttributes.name: data-accordion-item
dataAttributes.description: Identifies an item element.

dataAttributes.name: data-accordion-value
dataAttributes.description: The item value, serialized as a string.

dataAttributes.name: data-accordion-value-type
dataAttributes.description: The runtime type of the item value (string or number).

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item is expanded.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The accordion orientation: 'vertical' or 'horizontal'.

parts.name: Header
parts.description: A real heading element (h3 by default) wrapping the trigger.

props.name: level
props.description: Heading level of the rendered element, to match the surrounding document outline.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered heading element.

dataAttributes.name: data-accordion-header
dataAttributes.description: Identifies a header element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item is expanded.

parts.name: Trigger
parts.description: The button that toggles its panel. Exposes aria-expanded and aria-controls.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered trigger button.

dataAttributes.name: data-accordion-trigger
dataAttributes.description: Identifies a trigger element.

dataAttributes.name: data-accordion-value
dataAttributes.description: The item value, serialized as a string.

dataAttributes.name: data-accordion-value-type
dataAttributes.description: The runtime type of the item value (string or number).

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the element has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item is expanded.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The accordion orientation: 'vertical' or 'horizontal'.

parts.name: Panel
parts.description: The collapsible region, hidden and inert while collapsed.

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Keep the closed panel mounted (hidden) instead of unmounting it after the exit animation.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered panel element.

dataAttributes.name: data-accordion-panel
dataAttributes.description: Identifies a panel element.

dataAttributes.name: data-accordion-panel-content
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the inner content wrapper used for height animation.

dataAttributes.name: data-accordion-value
dataAttributes.description: The item value, serialized as a string.

dataAttributes.name: data-accordion-value-type
dataAttributes.description: The runtime type of the item value (string or number).

dataAttributes.name: data-closed
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item is collapsed.

dataAttributes.name: data-ending-style
dataAttributes.description: Present while the panel is collapsing, for CSS exit transitions.

dataAttributes.name: data-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item is expanded.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The accordion orientation: 'vertical' or 'horizontal'.

dataAttributes.name: data-starting-style
dataAttributes.description: Present for one frame when the panel starts expanding, for CSS transitions.
